title: Kusanagi Nene — Drive GO! GO!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's almost time...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry I'm late, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, it's okay. I know you're busy with band practice and everything, so thank you for coming.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's my pleasure.
I mean, I always learn so much when we practice singing together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Also...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Hoshino.
Let's make this year a good one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Kusanagi!
And yes, I'm hoping that we can.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I finally got a chance to tell you in person.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wanted to talk to you at the beach, but we had to scramble to keep our show going.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki said that you guys performed in a few different places that day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. On top of a mountain, at a ski resort, the mall...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The audience even behaved and reacted pretty differently based on where we performed. That was actually kind of interesting to see.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Speaking of which, you guys changed your dance routine based on how the audience members who volunteered sang, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Improvising wasn't easy, but I thought it was a good experience.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's incredible... I mean, I sort of froze up when Tsukasa asked me to sing that time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not many would know what to do in that situation...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you made it really easy for us to dance since you put on such a good singing performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not only that, more people began to gather after hearing you sing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I think it's incredible that you were able to do that on the spot.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, really.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wh-What do I do...? I've pretty much said everything that I was hoping to...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Um... What else is there...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, Kusanagi... Can I ask you something?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? S-Sure, what's up?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If you're interested, would you mind coming to see us perform again?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I got to see your band play a little during Shibuya Festa, but not at a live house yet.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So... Yes, I'd love to see one of your shows as long as it doesn't conflict with one of ours.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I really want to see you sing with your band at a live house, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Kusanagi!
I promise to let you know once we have a date for our next show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'm a little nervous about going to a live house...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Don't worry! I know they have a reputation for being kinda scary, but the place we play at is actually really nice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll have a good time!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, I'll make seeing one of your shows one of my New Year's resolutions.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Great! We'll make sure to practice and be ready for you whenever.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now, wanna start our first practice of the new year?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
